-A website builder is a platform that allows anyone to create a website without any coding knowledge. The best website builders offer drag and drop editing, AI-powered tools and customizable website templates, handling everything you need from design to hosting and even securing a domain. Wix offers an intuitive website builder that combines vibe coding with freeform drag and drop, and ready-to-use business solutions.
-Is it easy to build a website?

-Yes—you don’t need to know how to code. Wix is an intuitive no-code website builder with a few ways to create your own website, so you can choose the process that works best for you. Pick from 2000+ designer-made templates, use the AI website builder to create a business-ready site through a conversational interface, or start from scratch with Wix’s drag and drop website builder. Whichever way you choose, you can keep customizing in the Editor for total website design freedom—and add advanced functionality with code whenever you want.
-How do I choose the best website builder?

-The best website builder is one that supports your specific needs and business goals. Key factors to consider: Ease of use—an intuitive drag and drop editor with AI tools. Website templates—a large selection tailored to your industry. AI tools—that help with content, images and business insights, not just design. Business software—built-in solutions like eCommerce, scheduling and marketing tools. Apps and integrations—hundreds of Wix-made and 3rd party apps are available through the Wix App Market, including Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel and Zapier. Security and support—reliable hosting, data encryption and 24/7 customer care. A website builder will also cost you significantly less than hiring a developer—but if you want expert help, you can hire a freelance web developer through the Wix Marketplace at a cost that suits your budget.
-What types of websites can you build on Wix?

-With Wix’s free website creator, you can create any kind of website you want, including: Business sites—build and grow your professional presence online, whatever your industry. Online stores—sell products, offer subscriptions and run marketing campaigns with an all-in-one eCommerce solution. Blogs—share what’s on your mind with an easy-to-manage blog. Portfolios—showcase your work with beautiful visuals and custom layouts. Restaurants—take reservations, display your menu and run your ordering system from one place. Enterprise corporations—multi-site management and everything a big business needs.
-How much does it cost to build a website?

-With Wix, you can build your website and publish it completely free—design your site, publish it and share it with the world without spending a dime. To connect a custom domain, remove ads and unlock advanced business features like selling through an online store, you’ll need to upgrade to one of Wix’s Premium plans. Overall cost varies depending on the features you need—and can be significantly higher if you pay a developer instead of using an all-inclusive platform like Wix.
-Does my free website come with hosting?

-Yes. When you create a website with Wix, you get reliable, scalable multi-cloud web hosting that ensures 99.99% uptime, plus automatic disaster recovery and worldwide CDN coverage. Your site also comes with 2 layers of DDoS protection, 24/7 security monitoring and HTTPS and SSL protection, so your website is always safe and secure.
-How can I connect a domain to my website?

-Every free Wix site comes with a built-in Wixsite domain (i.e., mysite.wixsite.com). To look more professional and boost your credibility, you can get a new custom domain name for a year with the initial purchase of an annual Premium plan—through Wix's domain registration, choosing from over 400 domain extensions like .com, .net and .org. If you already own a domain name, you can connect or transfer it to your Wix site.
-How can I optimize my site for SEO on Wix?

-All Wix sites are designed with SEO best practices in mind and come with a suite of built-in SEO tools and guidance. Customize your SEO settings, use AI to generate meta tags and descriptions, and get instant homepage indexing. Your site also comes with an SEO assistant that analyzes your pages and recommends ways to improve search performance, plus key integrations like Google Search Console and Semrush. Check out this Google case study for more on Wix SEO.

+Wix is an all-in-one platform for creating a website and running your business online. Build with AI and drag and drop, register a domain, sell products, take bookings and market what you build. Free to start, with 300M+ sites built on it.

+No. Wix is an all-in-one platform for building your website and running your business with AI. Beyond the Wix Harmony editor, it includes Wix Studio for agencies and freelancers, and Wix Headless, which connects sites and apps built in any AI tool or framework to Wix’s business solutions.
+How do I get started on a site with Wix?

+Describe your site in a prompt, and Wix Harmony, our AI-powered editor, lays out a business-ready site for you. Or start from one of our 2,000+ Wix templates instead. Refine either by chatting with Aria, your personal AI agent, or by hand. Most people go from idea to published site in a matter of minutes.
+Can I create a site from ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool?

+Yes, with Wix Headless. Build your site or app in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex or another AI tool, then connect it to Wix in one prompt. Wix adds payments, bookings, a CMS and more, and puts it live on Wix hosting. You keep your code and can keep prompting to make changes. It's free to connect and you can upgrade when you’re ready to sell.
+What is the difference between Wix Harmony, Wix Studio and Wix Headless?

+Wix Harmony is Wix’s flagship AI website builder where small business owners can generate a business-ready site in minutes, then customize any detail with AI or by hand. Wix Studio is the professional platform for agencies and freelancers building client sites. Wix Headless connects a site or app built in any AI tool or framework to Wix’s business solutions in one prompt. Host it on Wix or on your own setup, like Vercel, Netlify or AWS. All three run on the same enterprise-grade infrastructure and provide all business and marketing tools.
+Is Wix free, and when do you need a paid plan?

+Yes, you can start on Wix for free. Build and publish a site without a credit card, and stay on your free plan for as long as you like. Every Wix site, free or paid, includes hosting, so you never set up a server or pay a separate provider. Free plans come with a Wix-branded domain; paid plans start affordably and add a custom domain, payments and more business features. Compare all Wix plans to find what fits.
+How can I connect or register a domain?

+Register a new domain with Wix, or connect one you already own, directly from your Wix dashboard — no technical setup or DNS knowledge needed. Once connected, your domain goes live automatically. Annual website plans include a custom domain free for the first year.
+Can I build an online store on Wix?

+Yes, with the Wix online store builder. Add a product catalog, inventory and checkout, and accept payments by card or digital wallet through Wix Payments or other providers — online and in person with POS. Building is free; you only need a paid plan to start accepting payments.

+{"author":{"uri":{"label":"https://itunes.apple.com/us/reviews/id1373812095"}, "name":{"label":"A Pressley"}, "label":""}, "updated":{"label":"2026-10-22T04:41:11-07:00"}, "im:rating":{"label":"4"}, "im:version":{"label":"6.99.0"}, "id":{"label":"14696876290"}, "title":{"label":"Keep improving"}, "content":{"label":"Overall, Jobber is a great platform, but there are several areas that definitely need improvement, particularly with the mobile app, AI Receptionist, client records, and third-party integrations. As a business owner who relies on Jobber daily, these are practical improvements that would make a significant difference in efficiency.

1. Technician Time Tracking

Business owners should be able to view technicians’ time entries and hours worked on individual jobs directly from the mobile app. This information should be readily accessible without having to switch to the desktop version.

2. AI Receptionist Call History

Every incoming call should have a clearly displayed date and timestamp. Phone numbers should also be clickable, allowing us to return calls directly from the AI Receptionist’s call history.

Currently, unless a caller submits an actual request that becomes associated with a client profile, we have to manually copy and paste the phone number to return the call. This is an unnecessary inconvenience that should be easy to correct.

3. Better Integration Between Pages

There needs to be more seamless navigation between AI Receptionist conversations, call history, client profiles, requests, and jobs. Information should be interconnected without requiring users to constantly switch between screens or manually transfer details.

4. Native Mobile Text Messaging

There should be an option to open a customer’s phone number in the device’s native text messaging app rather than being limited to messaging within Jobber.

Many customers initially contact us through regular text messages. Having the flexibility to communicate through our phone’s messaging app, while ideally maintaining a connection to their Jobber client profile, would be extremely valuable.

5. Centralized Client Attachments and Photos

All attachments, including photos and documents uploaded to individual jobs, should automatically populate in a centralized attachment section within the client’s main profile.

Currently, having to open individual jobs to locate previously uploaded photos or documents is unnecessarily time-consuming, especially when a customer has a long service history.

There should be one consolidated list or gallery showing every attachment associated with that customer, regardless of which job it was originally uploaded to. Ideally, each attachment would also link back to its original job for reference.

6. Better Two-Way Integration With CompanyCam

The CompanyCam integration is a great example of a feature that has potential but needs better connectivity.

I appreciate that Jobber can automatically create a corresponding project in CompanyCam. However, there should also be a direct link within the Jobber client or job profile that opens the associated CompanyCam project, and vice versa.

If the integration already connects the two platforms and creates the corresponding project, there should be no reason we can’t navigate directly between them. This would eliminate unnecessary searching and make the integration significantly more useful.

Overall Feedback

These aren’t extravagant feature requests. They’re basic workflow improvements that would save contractors and business owners considerable time throughout the day.

Jobber continues to introduce new features, particularly AI-powered tools, but I believe greater attention needs to be given to improving the functionality, navigation, and integration of the features already available.

A truly efficient platform should make information accessible from wherever you’re working, whether that’s a client’s profile, an individual job, the AI Receptionist, or an integrated application like CompanyCam.

I would really like to see these improvements prioritized and implemented sooner rather than later. Jobber is already a valuable business management tool, but addressing these everyday frustrations would make it substantially better for the contractors who depend on it.", "attributes":{"type":"text"}}, "link":{"attributes":{"rel":"related", "href":"https://itunes.apple.com/us/review?id=1014146758&type=Purple%20Software"}}, "im:voteSum":{"label":"0"}, "im:contentType":{"attributes":{"term":"Application", "label":"Application"}}, "im:voteCount":{"label":"0"}},
